svg.title: Every request is a round trip
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon map. A horse-drawn wagon carries a request from Your app through the Gate and the Router, then along four roads (OCR, Messages, Responses, Chat completions) to the model providers. Wooden stations off the road (Cache, Vault, Customs, Post office, Ledger) are numbered in the order a request visits them.
svg.text: Every request is a round trip
Today a request rides a Python wagon: through the gate, the router, and a stop at every station.
